Bench: Debangsu Basak
10.03.2025
Item No.28
 Court No. 26
 Chc
 Crm(Db) 685 of 2023

In re : An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of
 Criminal Procedure, 1973, in connection with Tehatta Police Station
 Case No. 451 of 2022 dated 4.6.2022 under Section 376 of the Indian
 Penal Code and Section 4 of Pocso Act.
 -And-

In the matter of : Narayan Halder  ... ...Petitioner  Mr. Rudradipta Nandy, Ld. A.P.P.
 Ms. Sonali Bhar, Advocate  ... ... For the State  1.
Two reports submitted in Court on behalf of the State be taken on record.
2. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that, the accused expired and therefore, the case was filed.
3. In the application for grant of bail, the coordinate Bench initiated steps for the purpose of establishing POCSO Court in the State of West Bengal at different districts.
4. There subsists an order dated April 1, 2024 enumerating 14 places in the State of West Bengal where, POCSO were required aggregating 18 in numbers.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor refers to two reports and submits that, subsequent to the proposal being sent to the Department of Finance, queries were raised which were duly answered and presently the file is pending with the Finance Department.
6. Last entry of sending file to the Finance Department is dated March 6, 2025.

sentences.text: Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that, appropriate steps were taken for the purpose of appointing Special Public Prosecutors.
He refers to the contents of the report in support of such contention.
8. 18 POCSO Courts are yet to be established since the file is presently lying with the Finance Department.

9. List the application on March 24, 2025 when the State will submit a fresh report as to the progress with regard thereto.
(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
